## Project Details
**Type:** Electron app with React TypeScript  
**Stack:** React + TypeScript + Vite + Electron + shadcn/ui  
**Features:**
- CheckList Final module (equipment verification with PDF generation)
- Guías de Despacho module (dispatch documentation with PDF)
- Light/Dark theme (default: light)
- Red/Black AlertPlus branding
- Multi-platform builds (Windows, macOS, Linux)
